column2: (1) The general objects for which the Corporation is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to promote activities in order to alleviate poverty
and  overcome  economical,  social  and  cultural
deficiency among rural communities;
to  bring  amity,  peace  and  harmony  among  rural
and  plantation  communities  irrespective  of  cast,
race, religious and ethnic variations;
to develop socio-economic conditions of rural and
plantation  communities  through  education,  self-

employment, 
vocational 
training, 
small
entrepreneurship and all other viable means;
to establish, maintain and promote projects for the
development  of  agricultural,  horticultural,
livestock,  other  rural  and  cottage  industries  and
find marketing opportunities for such industries;
to deveolp through unity and mutual understanding
the social status of rural workers and to minimize
the social setback of lower income group;
to  promote  special  programmes  for  women  to
integrate themselves in to overall development and
gender  equality;
to  grant  financial  assistance,  arrange  bank  loans
and  obtain  government  subsidies  for  rural  and
plantation  sectors;
to  organize  seminars,  workshops,  study  visits,
lectures  and  discussions,  grant  scholarships  and
awards,  organize  sports  and  cultural  activities  in
order  to  develop  skills  in  rural  and  plantation
sectors;
